description: Accurate on-device fluid identification is essential for microfluidic applications, yet maintaining reliability under varying flow, pressure, and temperature remains a key challenge. Existing learning-based methods often treat sensor signals as domain-agnostic features, neglecting the underlying physical relationships that govern fluid behavior, thereby limiting generalization and interpretability. To address this, we propose PRIMS, a physics-aware multimodal Transformer that integrates physical knowledge into representation learning and attention mechanisms through three dedicated modules:...
